name: Kirie Chika
source:
She has been working part-time at a public bathhouse since before Asahi arrived.
She is honest, quiet, and reserved. She does not get angry very often, but her emotions are clear.

Her bath at home is broken, so she rents a bath at Hime-no-yu after work.

She has a close relationship with Asahi's grandmother, who is like family.
She has a strong emotional attachment to the bathhouse and wants to continue to operate it.

She does not know that Asahi is a man, and since they are the same age, she is happy to have a good friend to talk with. She is happy to have made a good friend.

"Why don't we take a bath together? It feels really good."
